name: Pachi Pachi Circuit ~Yappa Race Queen wa "Hayai Otoko" ga Suki na wake yo~
original_name: ぱちぱちサーキット ～やっぱレースクイーンは「速い男」が好きな訳よ～
source:
You play as Junichi, the top driver of team AINOS, as he aims to win the championship.

Gameplay is turn-based "racing". Every turn you pick an angle and lob the car a few inches closer to the finish line.
translation:
玩家扮演AINOS车队的头号车手纯一，目标是赢得锦标赛冠军。

游戏采用回合制“赛车”玩法。每个回合，玩家选择一个角度，把汽车向终点方向弹射几英寸。
